title: Operational conditions of Yoshinogawa STP, Japan (FY 2009)

cell_spans.description: Printed header 'HRT (hrs)' spans the Anoxic and Oxic sub-headings
Printed single cell 75 covers the Average and Range rows; Return Sludge is printed separately for each row

notes: Source:Regional Sewerage Centre of Nara Prefecture, Japan, 2009

Transcriber layout note: headers are printed on two levels. The upper level reads 'Influent / Flow / (m³/d)' and 'HRT (hrs)'; the lower level reads 'Anoxic' and 'Oxic' under HRT. The flattened header labels above keep both printed parts.
Printed as ',810-2,370' for the MLSS range: the leading thousands digit is missing from the printed cell. Not corrected.
Printed Average Influent Flow is 50 while the printed Range of the same column is 8,287-11,265. Both are retained without reconciliation.
F/M and Sludge Age values are printed without units in the body; only the header carries '(days)' for Sludge Age.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 300-420 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Every header and cell read from a 300 dpi crop. Range cells read digit by digit, including the printed ',810-2,370' and '.058-0.122'.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every cell, header and note against 144-dpi region renders (all five rotated T5.29 regions included).
